title: NeuCME: Toward Dynamic Multimodal Continual Learning via Neural Combinatorics of Multiple Experts
abstract: arXiv:2609.07009v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal continual learning has recently shown great potential for developing agents with human-like intelligence by continuously learning new tasks across multiple modalities. However, existing methods typically assume that the set of modalities per task is predefined and fixed. In this paper, we investigate a more realistic learning setting, referred to as dynamic multimodal continual learning, in which the set of modalities may vary across tasks rather than remaining fixed. This setting involves two primary challenges: (i) spatio-temporal catastrophic forgetting and (ii) adaptive multimodal fusion. translated_title: NeuCME：通过多专家神经组合学迈向动态多模态持续学习
translated_abstract: 多模态持续学习最近在开发具有类人智能的智能体方面展现出巨大潜力，其通过跨多种模态持续学习新任务来实现。然而，现有方法通常假设每个任务的模态集合是预定义且固定的。本文研究了一种更现实的学习设置，称为动态多模态持续学习，其中模态集合可能因任务而异，而非保持固定。这一设置涉及两个主要挑战：（i）时空灾难性遗忘和（ii）自适应多模态融合。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了NeuCME（多专家神经组合学的简称），这是一个新颖的框架，旨在有效地学习和整合具有不同模态集合的任务间的知识。所提出的NeuCME模型包含三个关键组件，即模态组合……
tldr: 提出NeuCME框架，通过多专家神经组合学应对动态多模态持续学习中模态集合随任务变化的挑战，解决时空灾难性遗忘与自适应多模态融合两大核心问题。
en_tdlr: NeuCME is proposed as a novel framework leveraging neural combinatorics of multiple experts to tackle spatio-temporal catastrophic forgetting and adaptive multimodal fusion in dynamic multimodal continual learning, where the set of modalities varies across tasks.
